chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn, from Ibn Muskān, from ʿAnbasah ibn Muṣʿab, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who stands in the row behind the Imam, while there is no one on his left—how should he give salām? He said: One taslīmah to his right.

key_terms.الصَّفِّ: the prayer row in congregational salat
key_terms.تَسْلِيمَةً وَاحِدَةً: a single salutation at the end of salat
key_terms.خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ: behind the Imam in congregational prayer
key_terms.يُسَلِّمُ: he gives the concluding salām of the prayer

ai.seo_question: How should a person behind the Imam give taslīm if no one is on his left?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the manner of taslīm in salat for someone standing behind the Imam in the row when no one is on his left side. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that he should give a single taslīmah toward his right.
